datasheet.title: 7050X4 Series 100/200/400G Data Center Switches Data Sheet (Arista Networks, 03-0057-27, Aug 27th, 2025)

description: Arista 7050X4-48Y-4DF - a fixed 1RU data-centre switch with 48 x 25G SFP25 ports and 4 x 400G QSFP-DD ports, running EOS. The front carries the SFP25 cages in two stacked rows, the odd number on top, in four groups of six columns, with the four QSFP-DD cages as two stacked columns between the second and third groups. A teal strip between the rows carries each SFP25 cage's number and an orange one the QSFP-DD cages'. A status lamp for each SFP25 port runs along the bottom edge. Four system lamps (system, fan, PS1, PS2) are at the top right. The rear carries two hot-swap 500 W power supplies at the ends, three hot-swap fan modules, and the RJ-45 management port, the USB port and the RJ-45 console port. The same panel is ordered with front-to-rear air (-F) or rear-to-front air (-R).

name: 7050x4-48y-4df

chassis.note: Guide Table 1: 48.3 x 4.4 x 47.5 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.7 inches), 9.8 kg (21.5 lbs). Data sheet: 43.99 x 4.37 x 46.83 cm (17.3 x 1.72 x 18.43 in), 21 lbs (9.52 kg). The width: 48.3 cm is over the mounting ears, so the body between them, which is what is modelled, is the data sheet's 43.99 cm (440.0 here). The height is the data sheet's 43.7 (the guide rounds it to 4.4 cm). The depth is the guide's 47.5 cm (475.0), which agrees with the guide's 18.7 inches; the data sheet's 46.83 cm (18.43 in) is 6.7 mm less: the gap `depth`. The weight is the guide's 9.8 kg; the data sheet's 9.52 kg is in the gap `weight`. 1RU.

colour.note: The front plate is the median of bare-plate pixels in the guide's figure C-6.

configurations.note: Data sheet ordering information: DCS-7050X4-48Y-4DF-F and -R ("front-to-rear air, 2xAC" and "rear-to-front air, 2xAC"). The "#" SKU is described "no fans, no psu". The data sheet lists no DC SKU: the DC configurations are examples with no part number.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED, as arista/7050dx4-32s: the guide's rack-mounting figures are isometric and carry no measure, and the kit guides are not held. Recorded in the gap rack-ears.

environment.note: Guide Table 2: operating 0 to 40 C, storage -25 to 70 C, altitude 0 to 3,000 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing. Data sheet: storage -40 to 70 C. The storage temperature differs: gap `environment`, the guide's used.

front-legend.note: The figure prints the maker's wordmark at the top left from 4.8 to 24.3 mm across and 2.8 to 6.0 mm down, and the model "7050X4-48Y-4DF" in small type under it. THE WORDMARK IS NOT DRAWN: a logo-zone region is reserved over it and the plain model text is set.

front-ports.note: Figure C-6 at 1.882 px/mm anchored on the 440 mm body, tab centres from a pixel scan. Forty-eight SFP25 cages (ports 1 to 48) in two stacked rows and twenty-four columns in four groups of six, the tab centres of the first group running from 36.5 px at a pitch of 26.8 px, 14.24 mm (the registry's 14.25 mm SFP ganged pitch, which the cages abut at), so the cage centre of column 1 is 19.1 mm from the left of the body; the groups start at 19.1, 110.5, 258.3 and 349.9 mm. Four QSFP-DD cages in two stacked columns (49 over 50, 51 over 52) between the second and third groups, centred 206.2 and 233.5 mm from the left, a 27.3 mm pitch; they are 19.0 x 10.0 mm (std/qsfp-dd). The top row centres 18.7 mm and the bottom row 32.0 mm below the top, a row pitch of 13.3 mm. The cages are std/sfp-ganged (14.25 x 10.4 mm), the SFP28 cage the SFP25 port is. The belly-to-belly orientation is the library's convention (upper cage upright, lower turned 180); the figure is too small to show the latch side.

fru-bays.note: Guide Appendix E and the data sheet ("1+1 hot-swappable"): THE TWO POWER SUPPLIES AND THE THREE FAN MODULES ARE BAYS. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit. The guide draws no blank for an empty bay, so none is modelled.

gate-1-front.note: Figure C-6 passes at 0.5 percent. The raster is 830 x 223 pixels. The body between its plate edges measures 828 px wide and 82 px tall (aspect 10.1), against the data sheet's 439.9 / 43.7 = 10.07, so the figure is near-orthographic and carries geometry at 1.882 px/mm (the 440 mm body is the scale anchor). One pixel is 0.53 mm, so every front position is good to about 0.5 mm, and every one is `estimated` because it is read off a picture and no dimension states it. The cage columns were read from the white port-number tabs by their centres.

gate-1-rear.note: Figure D-1 as for arista/7050dx4-32s, the only 1RU rear the guide draws: three fan modules, which is what the data sheet gives this model ("Hot-swappable Fans 3 (N+1 redundant)"). The guide draws the rear generically and does not say which model uses which; the mapping by fan count, height and supply count is ESTIMATED.

lifecycle.note: Searched 2026-10-22 for an end-of-sale notice for the 7050X4-48Y-4DF on Arista's advisories and notices pages. No notice was found.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. Each carries an `empty` sentence. The 1RU grounding point is on the bottom of the chassis (guide section 4.2, Table 5 lists the 1RU models; the 7050X4-48Y-4DF is not in it); no figure measures it.

port-lamps.note: Guide Appendix A.1.2, Table 10: off the link is down, green link up, yellow software disabled, flashing yellow failed diagnostics. Figure C-6 draws a pair of green lamps under each SFP25 column at the bottom edge, 39.4 mm down and 2.9 mm either side of the column's centre: the left is modelled as the upper (odd) port's and the right as the lower (even) port's. The QSFP-DD cages show only unresolved dark marks; one lamp each is modelled at the side of the cage, as the 7050CX4-24D8's.

port-numbering.note: Figure C-6 (callout 1, "Port numbers") prints 1 over 2, 3 over 4, and so on across the four groups, 1 to 48, then 49 over 50 and 51 over 52 in the QSFP-DD columns, which sit between ports 24 and 25 in space and are numbered after 48. The odd number is the upper cage. The figure prints each number on a white tab over its cage and, smaller, in the coloured strip, an up arrow after an odd number and a down arrow after an even one. The numerals are set in the strip. EOS interface names are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: Guide Table 4 prints "190 W / 179 W" for this model, with typical ABOVE maximum, so it is wrong in at least one place. The data sheet's "Typical/Max Power" row prints "120W / 223W", typical "measured at 25C ambient with 50% load on all ports, excludes transceivers". The data sheet's figures are modelled and the guide's are in the gap `power-figures`. Supported supply: PWR-511-AC (guide Table 4); the data sheet adds PWR-511-DC.

rear.note: Figure D-1 as for arista/7050dx4-32s: PS1 left and PS2 right, supplies 73.5 mm wide at 4.0 and 362.3 mm across, the management block 83.0 to 101.0 mm across, three fan modules 78.6 mm wide at 107.7, 191.0 and 274.3 mm.

rear-fan.note: Data sheet "Fan Tray" row: "FAN-7011M-F" and "FAN-7011M-R" for the 7050X4-48Y-4DF. The three fan modules are bays that accept those two; the -R configurations seat the blue ones.
